operations.command: set -e; mkdir -p {{workDir}}/fakebin {{workDir}}/tree/bin {{workDir}}/tree/secrets {{workDir}}/tree/.venv {{workDir}}/tree/.direnv {{workDir}}/home; printf '%s\n' '[[audio]]' 'label = "Desk"' 'sink = "preset.sink"' 'volume = "40%"' > {{workDir}}/labels.toml; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' 'if [ "$1" = "get-default-sink" ]; then echo preset.sink; exit 0; fi' 'cat <<EOF' '[' '  {' '    "name": "preset.sink",' '    "description": "Preset Description"' '  },' '  {' '    "name": "extra.sink",' '    "description": "Extra Speakers"' '  }' ']' 'EOF' > {{workDir}}/fakebin/pactl; chmod +x {{workDir}}/fakebin/pactl; touch {{workDir}}/tree/regular.txt {{workDir}}/tree/bin/tool {{workDir}}/tree/secrets/password {{workDir}}/tree/.venv/ignored {{workDir}}/tree/.direnv/ignored; chmod 600 {{workDir}}/tree/regular.txt {{workDir}}/tree/bin/tool {{workDir}}/tree/secrets/password {{workDir}}/tree/.venv/ignored {{workDir}}/tree/.direnv/ignored; chmod 700 {{workDir}}/tree/bin/tool; touch {{workDir}}/tree/bin/data {{workDir}}/outside; chmod 600 {{workDir}}/tree/bin/data {{workDir}}/outside; ln -s ../outside {{workDir}}/tree/external; ln -s missing {{workDir}}/tree/dangling; ln -s "$(command -v sh)" {{workDir}}/tree/result; mkdir -p {{workDir}}/outside-dir; chmod 700 {{workDir}}/outside-dir; ln -s ../outside-dir {{workDir}}/tree/external-dir

set -e; env HOME={{workDir}}/home NIXOSCTL_ASSUME_ROOT_FOR_TESTS=true NIXOS_CONFIG_ROOT={{workDir}}/tree USER=$(id -un) ./build/nixosctl fix-permissions; env HOME={{workDir}}/home NIXOSCTL_ASSUME_ROOT_FOR_TESTS=true NIXOS_CONFIG_ROOT={{workDir}}/tree USER=$(id -un) ./build/nixosctl fix-permissions; mode() { if stat -c %a "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; then stat -c %a "$1"; else stat -f %Lp "$1"; fi; }; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/regular.txt)" = 644; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/bin/tool)" = 755; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/secrets/password)" = 600; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/.venv/ignored)" = 600; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/.direnv/ignored)" = 600; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/tree/bin/data)" = 644; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/outside)" = 600; test "$(mode {{workDir}}/outside-dir)" = 700; test -L {{workDir}}/tree/dangling; test -L {{workDir}}/tree/result; count=$(env HOME={{workDir}}/home git config --global --get-all safe.directory | grep -Fx -- {{workDir}}/tree | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$count" = 1; printf permissions-ok
